_note: Skyreach Peaks (Docs/Expansion.md §8, builder skyreach, prefixes sr / dg6). The map: Cairnhollow, the Switchbacks, the Bone Field, the Heronguard tower, the Dragonsworn vanguard and the Roost Gate.

maps.name: Skyreach Peaks
maps.subtitle: Snow, pines and the old dragon roads

props.text: West: Cairnhollow (hot tea, warm beds, opinions). North: the Wolf Den (do not). Far north-west: the Roost (absolutely do not).
Odran's hut. A pair of snowshoes hangs on the door, and a note: OUT GUIDING. OR IN. KNOCK.
The Kettle Hut. Smoke, tea and the sound of someone humming badly.
Brannoc's hut. The door is decorated with antlers, snowshoes and a sign that says PELTS BOUGHT, COATS SOLD, NO REFUNDS.
East: Cairnhollow and the Brightwater road. West and up: the Switchbacks, Two-Belly Ledge (pay the ogre or run fast). North: Flag Knoll and Glasswater Falls.
CAIRNHOLLOW NOTICES. Lost: three goats (answer to nothing). Wanted: wolf pelts, harpy-proof bells, and patience. Seen: a lot more smoke than usual over the Roost. Hilde says: wipe your boots.
A cairn of river stones. Each one has a name scratched on it, very small. You count twenty-nine.
A flat stone carved with a heron and a single line: THEY HELD THE FORDS. NOW WE HOLD THEM.
A little brass lantern, still lit. Its owner has wrapped it in his own scarf.
A cart full of 'toll': three left boots, a teapot, a saddle, and an enormous wheel of cheese with one bite out of it.
TOLL, painted in red. Underneath, smaller: 'Gorrum is not a good speller but Gorrum is a good puncher.'
A herders' cairn, built stone by stone over many years. Each stone means 'I got up here, and I got home again.'
A Dragonsworn banner over the drake pen. Someone has chalked underneath: 'Drakes are not dogs. —G.'
A cairn with a rusted spur on top.
A cairn with a heron feather tucked between the stones. It looks fresh.
A cairn. Someone has scratched AUBRIC into the top stone, then, smaller, SORRY WE WERE LATE.
A cairn with a cracked helmet on it, upside down, full of snow.
A cairn with a carved wooden heron, worn smooth by the wind.
A dragon's skull, painted with ember sigils. Candles burn in the eye sockets. Someone has been very busy being very ominous.

regions.name: Cairnhollow
regions.text: Cairnhollow: three huts, one fire, and a great many prayer flags arguing with the wind.

regions.name: Two-Belly Ledge
regions.text: Two-Belly Ledge. Somebody has painted TOLL on a boulder, then crossed it out and painted TOLL bigger.

regions.name: Whitebrow Hollow
regions.text: Whitebrow Hollow. The pines here grow close, and something large has been stacking snowballs in neat pyramids.

regions.name: Harpy Crags
regions.text: The Harpy Crags. Every ledge is decorated with stolen spoons.

regions.name: Windgap Overlook
regions.text: Windgap Overlook. The whole world falls away below you: the river, the fens, the downs, and far off a glint that might be Brightwater's weathervane.
regions.successText: Someone has wedged a waxed bundle under the cairn, out of the wind. A herder's cache, long forgotten.
regions.failText: The wind makes your eyes water. Lovely view, though.

regions.name: The Bone Field
regions.text: The Bone Field. Ribs taller than houses rise out of the snow, and the snow between them is grey with ash.

regions.name: Heronguard Tower
regions.text: The Heronguard tower. A blue banner still hangs from the broken top, faded to the colour of a winter sky.

regions.name: Vanguard Camp
regions.text: The Dragonsworn vanguard camp. Everything here smells of smoke, including the snow.

regions.name: The Roost Gate
regions.text: The Roost Gate. Ember-light turns inside the old stones, and far above the clouds a vast shape breathes in its sleep.

regions.name: The Frozen Falls
regions.text: Glasswater Falls, frozen in mid-tumble. Somewhere behind the ice, water still mutters to itself.
regions.successText: Behind a curtain of icicles the rock is not rock at all, but carved stone, and a cold draught breathes out of a doorway.
regions.failText: Ice, more ice, and a very cold nose.

regions.name: Glimmerwing's Shelf
regions.text: A wide shelf of old snow, scraped smooth by something with a very long tail.
